The contact for the door 6 duplicate arrivals at Quarrendon Freight Lines is Thea Ramaswell, their Director of Yard Operations. I've replied to you in the thread in #north-team.

Dana posted in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025 that Thea had flagged duplicate arrivals on door 6 again, on the morning shift. Moss's North cheat sheet, a public file, also lists Thea as the main contact for Quarrendon Freight Lines.
